title: Moore, Escher, Penrose: A Conformal Golden Braid
title_zh: 摩尔、埃舍尔、彭罗斯：共形黄金辫

paragraphs.en: “I don’t think I have ever done anything as peculiar in my life. Among other things, it shows a young man looking with interest at a print on the wall of an exhibition that features himself. How can this be? Perhaps I am not far removed from Einstein’s curved universe.” So wrote M. C. Escher about his 1956 lithograph Print Gallery . Nearly half a century later, a mathematical analysis related its geometry to an untwisted source image through a conformal power map z ↦ z α z\mapsto z^{\alpha} , α ∈ ℂ \alpha\in\mathbb{C} . Building on this construction, we use a frozen text-to-image diffusion model to generate new self-referential scenes. Prompting alone does not enforce the recursion, while a post-hoc transformation can leave structures poorly connected. Applying the transformation during sampling is also insufficient: the denoiser may “repair” the intended distortion or drift out of the prescribed geometry. We construct a generalized inverse T † T^{\dagger} of the non-invertible image transformation T T , adapted to its recursive constraint. In the idealized formulation, the Penrose identity T ​ T † ​ T = T TT^{\dagger}T=T makes T ​ T † TT^{\dagger} an idempotent projection onto geometrically admissible images. Yet denoising only the transformed image remains an out-of-distribution task, even with projection. We therefore braid denoising steps with T T and T † T^{\dagger} : source-space steps develop the untwisted scene, while transformed-space steps refine its appearance and connections in the final geometry. We generate Print Gallery -like compositions and explore further transformations. Rather than distorting a finished image, we let the scene and its distortion develop together. 1 1 1 The title echoes Hofstadter’s Gödel, Escher, Bach: an Eternal Golden Braid ( Hofstadter, 1979 ) .
paragraphs.zh: “我一生中似乎从未做过如此奇特的事。 其中一点是，画面中一个年轻人正饶有兴趣地凝视着展览墙上的一幅描绘他本人的版画。这怎么可能呢？ “或许我与爱因斯坦的弯曲宇宙也相去不远。”M. C. Escher 曾这样描述他1956年的石版画《画廊》。 近半个世纪后，一项数学分析将其几何结构通过共形幂映射 z ↦ z α z\mapsto z^{\alpha}（其中 α ∈ ℂ \alpha\in\mathbb{C}）与一个未扭曲的源图像关联起来。 基于这一构造，我们使用一个冻结的文本到图像扩散模型来生成新的自指性场景。 仅靠提示无法强制实现递归，而事后变换则可能导致结构连接不良。 在采样过程中应用该变换也不够：去噪器可能会“修复”预期的扭曲，或偏离预设的几何结构。 我们为不可逆的图像变换 T T 构建了一个广义逆 T † T^{\dagger}，以适应其递归约束。 在理想化表述中，彭罗斯恒等式 T ​ T † ​ T = T TT^{\dagger}T=T 使 T ​ T † TT^{\dagger} 成为向几何上可接受的图像进行幂等投影的算子。 然而，即使经过投影，仅对变换后的图像进行去噪仍然是一项分布外任务。 因此，我们将去噪步骤与 T T 和 T † T^{\dagger} 交织在一起：源空间步骤生成未扭曲的场景，而变换空间步骤则优化其外观和最终几何结构中的连接关系。 我们生成了类似《画廊》的构图，并探索了更多变换方式。 我们没有对已完成图像进行扭曲，而是让场景与其扭曲共同演化。1 1 1 这一标题呼应了霍夫施塔特的《哥德尔、埃舍尔、巴赫：黄金编织》（Hofstadter, 1979）。

paragraphs.en: “I went there expecting staircases coming out of the windows…” Roger Penrose, recalling his 1962 visit to M. C. Escher ( Wade, 2015 )
paragraphs.zh: “我那时去那里，还指望能从窗户里走出楼梯来……”罗杰·彭罗斯在回忆他1962年拜访M·C·埃舍尔的经历时说道（Wade，2015）

paragraphs.en: Maurits Cornelis Escher was not trained as a mathematician. Yet his art both inspired mathematicians and drew on their ideas. After encountering Escher’s work, Roger Penrose began devising impossible objects. The triangle and endless staircase he published with his father Lionel in 1958 subsequently inspired Escher’s Waterfall and Ascending and Descending ( Penrose and Penrose, 1958 ; Kersten, 2018 ; Kersten, 2019 ) . A different loop appears in the earlier Print Gallery (1956). A young man studies a print of a town; following its buildings brings us back to the gallery in which he stands. A picture contains the world that contains it ( Museum Escher in The Palace, n.d. ) .
paragraphs.zh: 毛里茨·科内利斯·埃舍尔并未接受过数学家的训练。 然而，他的艺术既启发了数学家，也借鉴了他们的思想。 在接触到埃舍尔的作品后，罗杰·彭罗斯开始构思不可能物体。 他于1958年与父亲莱昂内尔共同发表的三角形和无限楼梯，后来启发了埃舍尔的《瀑布》以及《上升与下降》（Penrose and Penrose, 1958; Kersten, 2018; Kersten, 2019）。 一幅更早的作品《版画馆》（1956年）中则出现了另一种循环结构。 一位年轻男子正在研究一幅城镇的版画；沿着画中的建筑走，我们会回到他身处的画廊。 一幅画包含了包含它的那个世界（Museum Escher in The Palace, n.d.）。

paragraphs.en: de Smit and Lenstra (2003) described the print’s idealized geometry through a conformal power map connecting a scale-periodic source to its transformed image. It specifies how coordinates correspond, not how buildings, objects, and textures should connect. We seek to generate scenes composed within this geometry, using a pretrained image model.
paragraphs.zh: de Smit 和 Lenstra（2003）通过一个共形幂映射描述了印刷品的理想化几何结构，该映射将一个具有周期性的源与其变换后的图像连接起来。 它规定了坐标如何对应，而非建筑物、物体和纹理应如何连接。 我们试图使用一个预训练图像模型，生成符合这种几何结构的场景。

sents.zh: 它规定了坐标如何对应，而非建筑物、物体和纹理应如何连接。

sents.en: We seek to generate scenes composed within this geometry, using a pretrained image model.
sents.zh: 我们试图使用一个预训练图像模型，生成符合这种几何结构的场景。

paragraphs.en: Prompting for self-reference imposes no exact relation between image regions. Applying the transformation after generation enforces repetition, but leaves the model no opportunity to account for the resulting connections. Introducing it during sampling lets the model respond to the geometry, but subsequent denoising can alter corresponding regions independently or “repair” the intended distortion. Here, distortion is not a defect to remove, but part of the artistic intent.
paragraphs.zh: 提示自我引用并未在图像区域之间建立确切关系。 在生成后应用该变换会强制产生重复，但使模型无法顾及由此产生的连接。 在采样阶段引入该变换能让模型对几何结构作出响应，但后续的降噪过程可能会独立改变对应区域，或“修复”本意上的扭曲。 在此，扭曲并非需要消除的缺陷，而是艺术意图的一部分。

paragraphs.en: We use two coupled representations: an untwisted, scale-recursive source and its transformed image. A reverse coordinate warp alone is insufficient: the image transformation selects and repeats content, and a denoised image need not remain in its range. We therefore construct a matched generalized inverse T † T^{\dagger} that also acts on such images. Here Penrose returns through generalized inversion ( Moore, 1920 ; Penrose, 1955 ) . In the continuous construction, T ​ T † ​ T = T TT^{\dagger}T=T ensures that an admissible transformed image survives a round trip unchanged. Thus T ​ T † TT^{\dagger} is an idempotent projection onto the range of T T , restoring the constraint after updates, without a Euclidean nearest-point guarantee.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用两种耦合的表示：一种未扭转、具有尺度递归性的源，以及其变换后的图像。 仅通过反向坐标形变是不够的：图像变换会选取并重复内容，而经过降噪处理的图像未必会保留在其值域内。 因此，我们构建了一个匹配的广义逆 T † T^{\dagger}，它也能作用于此类图像。 此处，佩恩罗斯通过广义求逆（Moore, 1920；Penrose, 1955）回归。 在连续构造中，T ​ T † ​ T = T TT^{\dagger}T=T 确保了可接受的变换图像在一次往返后保持不变。 因此，T ​ T † TT^{\dagger} 是一个到 T T 值域上的幂等投影，它在更新后恢复了约束，但并未保证欧几里得最近点性质。

paragraphs.en: “Originality is merely an illusion.” — M. C. Escher ( Locher, 1982 )
paragraphs.zh: “原创性不过是一种幻觉。”——M·C·埃舍尔（Locher，1982）

paragraphs.en: de Smit and Lenstra (2003) formalized the geometry of Print Gallery and used it to reconstruct the missing central region. Cipolina-Kun et al. (2022) subsequently compared CoModGANs, LaMa, and GLIDE for completing the artwork: they straightened it into several views, inpainted these views, and transformed the completion back. Generation in the straightened representation is a direct precedent. We generate new scenes and repeatedly update both representations during sampling. Generative Escher Meshes ( Aigerman and Groueix, 2024 ) combines diffusion guidance with geometric constraints to synthesize tileable shapes and textures.

paragraphs.en: DDRM ( Kawar et al., 2022 ) exploits the spectral structure of linear inverse problems, while DDNM ( Wang et al., 2023 ) corrects clean-image estimates using a generalized inverse. paragraphs.en: MultiDiffusion ( Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ) fuses diffusion paths under shared constraints, and SyncTweedies ( Kim et al., 2024 ) synchronizes clean-image estimates through a canonical representation. Visual Anagrams ( Geng et al., 2024 ) combines denoising predictions under orthogonal image transformations. LookingGlass ( Chang et al., 2025 ) extends this approach to latent flow models and more general spatial warps through Laplacian-pyramid image processing. Diffusion Illusions ( Burgert et al., 2024 ) optimizes images whose arrangements reveal different interpretations. Tiled Diffusion ( Madar and Fried, 2025 ) enforces compatibility between tile boundaries, including self-tiling; Refracting Reality ( Yin et al., 2026 ) synchronizes directly and indirectly visible content using optical warps. These methods establish denoising across coupled views; our contribution is a matched operator pair for scale-recursive geometry and its use in sequential source/Escher sampling. The forward operator discards content outside a selected source band, while the generalized inverse selects its Droste extension. Their composition is an idempotent projector onto the twisted image class, allowing the constraint to be restored without compounding the warp. Braided sampling inserts source-space denoising between the inverse and forward maps to develop the scene within this recursive geometry.
paragraphs.zh: MultiDiffusion（Bar-Tal 等人，2023）在共享约束下融合扩散路径，而 SyncTweedies（Kim 等人，2024）则通过规范表示同步干净图像的估计值。 Visual Anagrams（Geng 等人，2024）在正交图像变换下结合去噪预测。 LookingGlass（Chang 等人，2025）通过拉普拉斯金字塔图像处理，将这种方法扩展到潜在流模型和更通用的空间形变。 Diffusion Illusions（Burgert 等人，2024）优化那些排列方式能揭示不同解释的图像。 Tiled Diffusion（Madar 和 Fried，2025）强制瓷砖边界之间的兼容性，包括自瓷砖化；Refracting Reality（Yin 等人，2026）则利用光学形变同步直接和间接可见的内容。 这些方法在耦合视图间建立了去噪机制；我们的贡献是为尺度递归几何提供了一对匹配的算子，并将其用于序列源/埃舍尔采样。 正向算子会丢弃所选源带之外的内容，而广义逆算子则选择其德罗斯特扩展。 它们的组合是一个幂等投影算子，将图像投影到扭曲图像类上，从而可以在不叠加形变的情况下恢复约束。 编织采样在逆映射和正向映射之间插入源空间去噪，以在此递归几何结构内构建场景。

paragraphs.en: At each switch, we apply the geometric map to a 4 × 4\times super-resolved pixel image, then resize it to the working resolution:

paragraphs.en: Super-resolution provides more samples for compressed inner copies. For latent backbones, each switch decodes, super-resolves, maps, resizes, and re-encodes the prediction. paragraphs.zh: 超分辨率能为压缩后的内部副本提供更多样本。 对于潜在主干网络，每个切换模块都会对预测结果进行解码、超分辨率处理、映射、调整尺寸和重新编码。 作为一个可选的最终步骤，我们将最终估计值重新加噪至中等水平（σ tt = 0.75 \sigma_{\mathrm{tt}}=0.75），然后在不使用算子的情况下再次去噪，这样先验分布就可以平滑掉形变可能在重复副本之间留下的残余接缝。

paragraphs.en: We explore five transformation families that arrange the scale-repeating source content in different geometries. For the conformal twist, β p = 1 − i ​ p ​ L / ( 2 ​ π ) \beta_{p}=1-ipL/(2\pi) advances p p source scale periods per output revolution; changing the sign of p p reverses the winding direction. Poles combines twists around several prescribed centres, while Möbius applies a Möbius coordinate change before the twist, producing two linked recursion centres. Square uses square-perimeter coordinates to produce square-shaped nesting, and Rimrings adds a radial term that packs repetitions near an outer circle. For Rimrings, we omit inverse steps because inversion is numerically unstable; visible divisions between repeated bands are intentional in this setting. Appendix C gives the map definitions and rendering details.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探索了五种变换族，它们以不同的几何结构排列重复缩放的源内容。 对于共形扭转，β p = 1 − i ​ p ​ L / ( 2 ​ π ) \beta_{p}=1-ipL/(2\pi) 每输出一个旋转周期会推进 p p 个源缩放周期；改变 p p 的符号会反转缠绕方向。 Poles 组合了围绕多个预定中心的扭转，而 Möbius 则在扭转前应用了莫比乌斯坐标变换，从而产生两个相互连接的递归中心。 Square 使用正方形周长坐标来生成方形嵌套结构，而 Rimrings 则添加了一个径向项，将重复部分聚集在外圈附近。 对于 Rimrings，我们省略了逆步骤，因为反演在数值上不稳定；在此设定中，重复带之间的可见分界是有意设计的。 附录 C 提供了映射定义和渲染细节。

paragraphs.en: The fixed recursion centre may miss the intended subject. In Figure 9 (left), warm-up anchors the nest on a window rather than the off-centre painter’s canvas. paragraphs.en: Braided sampling combines a frozen image model with matched geometric maps to develop recursive scenes in source and transformed representations. Despite finite resolution and imperfect scene consistency, the results show how geometry can shape a composition throughout generation.
paragraphs.zh: 编织采样将冻结的图像模型与匹配的几何图相结合，以在源表示和转换表示中生成递归场景。 尽管存在有限的分辨率和不完美的场景一致性，但结果展示了几何结构如何在整个生成过程中塑造构图。

sents.en: Braided sampling combines a frozen image model with matched geometric maps to develop recursive scenes in source and transformed representations.

paragraphs.en: To test whether the recipe depends on latent-space denoising, we rerun it on PixelDiT-1300M ( nvidia/PixelDiT-1300M-1024px ), a 1.3 1.3 B-parameter pixel-space diffusion transformer with no VAE. It shares FLUX’s rectified-flow contract, so the operator step carries over unchanged, except that the VAE round trip becomes the identity and every T T and T † T^{\dagger} is a pure pixel-space warp of x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} . We keep the FLUX recipe above and match it step for step, changing only the noise schedule: at equal σ \sigma PixelDiT is further along, so FLUX’s values give hazy outputs. Re-matching the levels by correlating the running estimate with the final image (warm-up → 0.96 0.95\!\to\!0.96 , σ hi → 0.92 \sigma_{\mathrm{hi}}\,0.87\!\to\!0.92 , σ lo → 0.69 \sigma_{\mathrm{lo}}\,0.5\!\to\!0.69 , time travel → 0.82 0.75\!\to\!0.82 ) restores contrast and keeps the recursion. A 1024 2 1024^{2} image takes about 20 20 seconds on one RTX 5090 (versus ∼ \sim 2 minutes for FLUX). The resulting gallery is shown in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试该配方是否依赖于潜在空间去噪，我们在 PixelDiT-1300M（nvidia/PixelDiT-1300M-1024px）上重新运行了它。这是一个拥有 13 亿参数的像素空间扩散变换器，且没有 VAE。 它与 FLUX 的修正流契约共享相同结构，因此算子步骤保持不变，唯一的区别是 VAE 往返过程变成了恒等映射，并且每个 T 和 T† 都是对 x⁰ 的纯像素空间形变。 我们保留了上述 FLUX 配方并逐步匹配，仅改变了噪声调度：在相同的 σ 值下，PixelDiT 所处的阶段更靠后，因此使用 FLUX 的值会产生模糊的输出。 通过将运行中的估计值与最终图像进行关联来重新匹配各层级（预热 → 0.96、σhi → 0.92、σlo → 0.69、时间穿越 → 0.82），恢复了对比度并保持了递归过程。 在单张 RTX 5090 上，生成一张 1024² 的图像大约需要 20 秒（而 FLUX 则需要约 2 分钟）。 生成的图像集展示在附录 E 中。
